findings.title: evaluate_group_key_value calls build_occurrence_and_event_data with raw value, not necessarily matching group_key's current value semantics
findings.body: In evaluate_group_key_value, build_occurrence_and_event_data is called with 'value' (the raw metric value for this evaluation), but the abstract method's signature/docstring doesn't clarify units or validate correctness. If a subclass's new_status is e.g. OK transitioning to non-OK, the value passed may not correspond to what caused the status change if multiple conditions were evaluated across different value representations. This is minor but could confuse implementers producing occurrence evidence.

findings.title: Removed duplicate group_key detection without replacement safeguard
findings.body: The previous process_detectors logic explicitly checked for duplicate group_keys from detector_results and logged an error, skipping duplicates. Now that evaluate returns a dict keyed by group_key, duplicates are implicitly deduped by dict insertion order, silently overwriting the first result without any logging or metric. This removes an existing data-integrity safeguard/signal that previously surfaced bugs in detector implementations producing colliding group keys; now such bugs will fail silently (lost occurrence) instead of being logged.

findings.title: New abstractmethod build_occurrence_and_event_data breaks existing non-stateful DetectorHandler subclasses only partially
findings.body: Adding @abc.abstractmethod build_occurrence_and_event_data to StatefulDetectorHandler is a breaking API change for all existing subclasses of StatefulDetectorHandler that don't implement this method; they will fail to instantiate. The PR only updates grouptype.py's MetricAlertDetectorHandler (which doesn't implement it either, so it will raise TypeError when instantiated), and the test's MockDetectorStateHandler. Any other subclasses in the codebase not shown here (or added later) will break without a clear error message tied to this specific hook; the TODO comment in grouptype.py doesn't mention this requirement for implementers.
